title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
Part 2 of 5 is in. Every event kind has a payload, and `RewindEvent` narrows on `event.type`. Type tests cover `mutation`, `network`, and `input`, plus a switch that reads all 12 kinds. There is no `any`.

The payload shapes are recorded in `docs/decisions/0005-event-payload-shapes.md`: `null` for missing network, console, and error fields; a document root for a full snapshot; input split by `kind` into text and checked.

Checks on `c1730e2`: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` all passed. Parts 3–5 are still open, so this PR stays a draft.
